acceptance: All 40 paired 128-turn worlds complete with immutable registered code, unchanged rules, same-host segments, same world RNG, fixed personality and exact actual action/feedback owner replay.

Compare directly with the adopted H16 recovery owner, not only an unadopted H32 baseline. This is a combined quality comparison, not a causal attribution of each mechanism or an equal-compute comparison.
Mean final purpose must be nonnegative separately in every rule family. Gains elsewhere cannot offset a family loss.
Gambling mean final purpose and mean conditional increment differences must both be positive; at least 3 of 4 full-persona world means must improve.
Resources must retain positive mean final-purpose and conditional-increment gains. Review all adverse individual outcomes and retained differences among personalities.
Do not tune personality coefficients, add game/action-name branches, replace unfavorable seeds, truncate persistent worlds or retroactively relax criteria.

Include prior failed candidates, all completed and incomplete conditions, disagreement frequency and calculation cost. Long-horizon/root diagnosis and old stress evidence remain separate prerequisites for adoption.
